title: SECTION VIII — DOUBT, EXPERIENCE, HISTORY AND JUSTICE
summary: The final main section turns from doubt and experience toward history, law and justice. Its poems move through empiricism, analysis, pragmatic meaning, phenomenology and existential freedom, logical truth, faith and evil, secular life, ethics, historical understanding and the relation between written law and an inner demand for justice.
